name: v2.28.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Correct `--unbuffered` row counts by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2283
* Let `--unbuffered` use same state-update interval by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2284
* Add "streaming" state for `--unbuffered` queries by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2285
* Fix a brief blankout of query state feedback by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2286
* Add `doc/known_bugs.md` for known bugs and limitations. by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2287
* Add `doc/cookbook.md` for recipes on mycli usage and configuration by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2288
* Replace `pyfzf` dependency with internal version by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2289
* Add some items to the `known_bugs.md` doc by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2290
* Checkup mode: `sqlglotc` library is optional for performance by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2291
* Add history highlighting to known bugs doc by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2292
* Use outside copy of `uv` when running `tox` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2294
* Load special commands under Python 3.15 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2295
* Use forward-slash `/command` forms in behave test suite by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2296
* Prefer forward-slash `/commands` in pytest tests by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2297
* Add a tox typecheck command by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2298
* Add a typecheck step to the `publish.yml` workflow by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2299
* Prepare changelog for release v2.28.0 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2300


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.27.0...v2.28.0
